fields.label: Picked pairs: TLS file
fields.help: Coarse alignment (choose one method). Full path to the TLS picked-points file (CloudCompare point list picking export, GLOBAL coordinates). Give both pair files or neither.

fields.label: Picked pairs: photo file
fields.help: Full path to the photo picked-points file, same point order as the TLS file.

fields.label: Holdout pairs
fields.help: Hold out the LAST k pairs as check points.

fields.label: Check points: TLS file
fields.help: Separate check-point files (used only for validation). Give both or neither.

fields.label: Check points: photo file
fields.help: Photo half of the separate check points.

fields.label: Init (identity | matrix file)
fields.help: Start from 'identity' (clouds already roughly aligned) or a 4x4 matrix file path. Empty = not passed.

fields.label: Global shift TLS (X Y Z)
fields.help: CloudCompare 'Global shift' of the TLS cloud, three numbers space-separated, if the init matrix comes from CloudCompare and the clouds were shifted.

fields.label: Global shift photo (X Y Z)
fields.help: CloudCompare 'Global shift' of the photo cloud (same purpose).

fields.label: Auto coarse (FPFH+RANSAC)
fields.help: FPFH+RANSAC automatic coarse alignment (needs open3d).

fields.label: Topview coarse
fields.help: Gravity-aware top-view automatic coarse alignment (v0.5, no pairs needed).

fields.label: Auto voxel (m)
fields.help: Voxel for the automatic coarse alignment.

fields.label: Top-view cell (m)
fields.help: Top-view raster cell (m).

fields.label: Yaw hint (DEG HALFWIN)
fields.help: Optional yaw prior for topview, two numbers, e.g. '40 30' searches 10..70 deg.

fields.label: Working-sample voxel (m)
fields.help: Working-sample voxel (m), default 0.05.

fields.label: Max sample points
fields.help: Cap on working-sample points (memory).

fields.label: Max points per ICP level
fields.help: Points per ICP level.

fields.label: First ICP level voxel (m)
fields.help: First ICP level voxel (m).

fields.label: Explicit ICP levels
fields.help: Explicit ICP voxel levels, space-separated, e.g. '0.5 0.2 0.1 0.05'. Empty = automatic.

fields.label: Correspondence factor
fields.help: Max correspondence distance = factor x voxel.

fields.label: QA threshold (m)
fields.help: Distance threshold for fitness / QA (m).

fields.label: Skip ICP
fields.help: Only coarse alignment + QA.

fields.label: Do not write registered TLS
fields.help: Do not write the registered full TLS (the 'registered' artifact will then be absent - a warning, not an error).

fields.label: Chunk size (points)
fields.help: Advanced: points per chunk (memory knob).

fields.label: Workers
fields.help: Threads for neighbour searches (-1 = all).
